verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents several programmatic surfaces. The SQL API can run queries and manage the deployment (provisioning users and roles, creating tables). REST APIs for resource management ship with official OpenAPI specs and Postman collections. Snowflake CLI manages apps across workloads, and a managed MCP server exposes tools and SQL execution to agents. Monitoring data such as access history is also queryable through views rather than only through Snowsight. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or mapping of UI-to-API parity (e.g. whether Snowsight features like the Query History page and query profile have full API equivalents), and independent or hands-on confirmation that nothing is UI-only.
